headline: SpaceX Starship reaches orbit, deploys new Starlink satellites
summary: SpaceX's Starship rocket reached orbit for the first time, deploying the first next-generation Starlink V3 satellites, 26 of which rode atop the rocket. The flight completed the final stretch after Starship had already flown 99 percent of the way to low-Earth orbit. Outlets differ on how smoothly it went, citing either "drama" or "small hiccups."
